question: 如何为声信号频谱与 PSD 明确单位、窗 / 单侧 / 平均标度、估计不确定性和频带积分？
screening: 人工按研究对象与问题关系判断；非关键词自动打分。抽象筛选不等于全文阅读。

candidates.title: The use of fast Fourier transform for the estimation of power spectra: A method based on time averaging over short, modified periodograms
candidates.rationale: 以短段修正周期图平均进行数字功率谱估计，是本稿 Welch 方法的原始出处；采用 IBM 原始摘要与官方实现文档。
candidates.screening_basis: title, metadata and available abstract excerpt

candidates.title: Debiasing Welch’s method for spectral density estimation
candidates.rationale: 直接研究有限样本 Welch 偏差和方差取舍及去偏估计；取得出版 PDF，采用前四页和相关方法部分。
candidates.screening_basis: title, metadata and available abstract excerpt

candidates.title: Biased Estimations of Variance and Skewness
candidates.rationale: 研究星系分布高阶矩的比值偏差，目标是空间统计中的偏度，不是均匀采样声信号 PSD 的标度。
candidates.screening_basis: title, metadata and available abstract excerpt

candidates.title: Estimation of power spectral density from laser Doppler data via linear interpolation and deconvolution
candidates.rationale: 题名提示激光多普勒不规则数据的插值和反卷积，涉及特殊测量链；无摘要，仅暂定背景，不推断结果。
candidates.screening_basis: title and metadata only; provisional relevance, no findings inferred

candidates.title: Spectral Density Estimation of Function-Valued Spatial Processes
candidates.rationale: 研究 Hilbert 空间函数值空间过程与空间采样，超出本稿标量时间信号和 Hz 标度。
candidates.screening_basis: title, metadata and available abstract excerpt

candidates.title: Stationary Graph Processes and Spectral Estimation
candidates.rationale: 把平稳性扩展到图上的随机信号，频率定义为图谱，本稿不讨论图域。
candidates.screening_basis: title, metadata and available abstract excerpt

candidates.title: DeepMMSE: A Deep Learning Approach to MMSE-Based Noise Power Spectral Density Estimation
candidates.rationale: 研究非平稳噪声的 MMSE / 深度学习 PSD 跟踪，与言语增强有关；属应用方法，未采用性能结论或正文引用。
candidates.screening_basis: title, metadata and available abstract excerpt

candidates.title: Bias-Variance Tradeoffs in Joint Spectral Embeddings
candidates.rationale: 网络联合谱嵌入的偏差方差分析，谱是矩阵嵌入结构，不能作为声学 PSD 依据。
candidates.screening_basis: title, metadata and available abstract excerpt

candidates.title: Automatic spectral density estimation for random fields on a lattice via bootstrap
candidates.rationale: 题名为格点随机场自助法估计；无摘要，仅候选背景，空间维度超出范围。
candidates.screening_basis: title and metadata only; provisional relevance, no findings inferred

candidates.title: Allan Variance is Bootstrap Aggregation for Spectral Estimation
candidates.rationale: 说明时钟与惯性传感器 Allan 方差和谱估计的联系，作为应用线索；不用于声音分析的定量结论。
candidates.screening_basis: title, metadata and available abstract excerpt

candidates.title: Estimation of spectral density of a stationary time series via an asymptotic representation of the periodogram
candidates.rationale: 用周期图渐近表示构建平稳时间序列谱密度估计，包含线性和贝叶斯方法；不进入本稿实现比较。
candidates.screening_basis: title, metadata and available abstract excerpt

candidates.title: Spectral density estimation for symmetric stable p-adic processes
candidates.rationale: 估计 p-adic 稳定过程的谱与渐近性质，数学对象不同，不适合本稿入门到实践范围。
candidates.screening_basis: title, metadata and available abstract excerpt

candidates.title: Discussion, Emphasizing the Connection Between Analysis of Variance and Spectrum Analysis
candidates.rationale: 讨论固定周期时间函数的方差分析与谱分析关系，提供历史背景；不作为当前窗归一化依据。
candidates.screening_basis: title, metadata and available abstract excerpt

candidates.title: A Direct Digital Method of Power Spectrum Estimation
candidates.rationale: 原始数字谱估计以正弦余弦直接组合样本并与协方差间接法比较，是 Welch 方法历史背景；仅摘要筛选。
candidates.screening_basis: title, metadata and available abstract excerpt

candidates.title: An Exploratory Study of the Bi-Spectrum of Economic Time Series
candidates.rationale: 研究经济时间序列二次非线性和双谱，是高阶统计扩展；本稿只讨论二阶 PSD。
candidates.screening_basis: title, metadata and available abstract excerpt

candidates.title: Discussion, Emphasizing the Connection between Analysis of Variance and Spectrum Analysis
candidates.rationale: 同名方差分析讨论记录缺摘要；可能为不同数据库版本，保留 ID，不假定已读或误合并。

candidates.title: An open-source, high-performance tool for automated sleep staging

candidates.title: Practical Approach to Asynchronous Multivariate Time Series Anomaly Detection and Localization

candidates.title: Methodological considerations for studying neural oscillations

candidates.title: Security and Privacy on 6G Network Edge: A Survey

candidates.title: Spectrum estimation and harmonic analysis

candidates.title: Solving Least Squares Problems.

candidates.title: Time Series Analysis and Its Applications
